items.detail: The **Nasdaq jumped 2.26% to a record 27,122** and the S&P 500 added 1.49% to 7,765, its best day since early August.
items.why: The 10-year yield fell back below 5% and oil slid again, reviving the AI trade.

items.detail: Chips did the heavy lifting — **AMD rose about 10%** to top **$1 trillion in market value** for the first time, with Intel up 12%.
items.why: Fresh signs that AI spending is still expanding undid last week's selloff over AI safety warnings.

items.detail: The **10-year Treasury yield slipped to 4.951%**, back under 5%, leaving Wednesday's flash PMIs as the week's first real test of the rate path.
items.why: Global borrowing costs eased and crude fell a fourth straight day, taking pressure off the long end.

items.detail: **MSCI's emerging-market stock index rose 1.1%** to its highest in over a week, led by Samsung, TSMC and MediaTek.
items.why: Officials called US-China talks very successful ahead of this week's presidential summit, and oil fell a fourth day.

items.detail: The **Sensex jumped 564 points to 74,858.99** and the Nifty closed at 23,414, but **FIIs sold ₹576 crore** after Friday's brief buying.
items.why: Cheaper crude and bargain buying in heavyweights lifted the index, while domestic funds absorbed the renewed foreign selling.

items.detail: **The Russell 2000 rose only 0.52% to 2,875**, far behind the Nasdaq, while India's **Nifty Smallcap 100 slipped 0.07%** despite the Sensex rally.
items.why: The day's buying went to AI megacaps, and still-high financing costs keep small caps hostage to the rate outlook.

items.detail: **Bitcoin reclaimed $85,000 for the first time in eight months**, trading near **$86,300** after a roughly 7% jump on Monday.
items.why: Falling oil and yields revived risk appetite, and another wave of short liquidations amplified the move.

items.detail: **Ether rose about 5.9% to roughly $2,715**, joining the rally but again trailing bitcoin's gain.
items.why: Ether funds shed $141 million last week, so the move came from short covering rather than fresh institutional money.

items.detail: **Solana jumped 8.3% to about $115.90**, outpacing both bitcoin and ether on the day.
items.why: Solana ETFs pulled in $61 million last week, led by Bitwise's BSOL, and a short squeeze did the rest.

items.detail: **Spot gold slipped about 0.5% to roughly $4,353 an ounce**, giving back Friday's one-week high.
items.why: Traders focused on the rate outlook over fresh US-Iran threats, and falling oil cut inflation-hedging demand.

crossCuttingTheme: The 10-year yield's drop back below 5%, helped by a fourth straight fall in oil, was the day's single lever: it powered record highs in AI chips, lifted EM stocks and crypto, and took the shine off gold.
